name: gflow
description: Drive Google Flow from your agent: Veo text-to-video, image-to-video and clip extension, Imagen images, reusable Characters and scene composition.

acknowledgeBilling.title: I understand this plugin can spend my Google account's Veo credits
acknowledgeBilling.description: gflow's MCP server drives a real Chrome session signed in to your own Google account. Video generation bills against that account's Flow credit allowance. Images and composition are free; only Veo video spends. Enabling this plugin starts the MCP server automatically.
